title: Merge Intervals
goal: Solve Merge Intervals: Sort intervals by start and extend the current merged end while the next interval overlaps it.
strategy: Sort intervals by start and extend the current merged end while the next interval overlaps it.
edgeCases: A contained interval cannot shorten the merged end; touching endpoints merge for closed intervals.
inputRules: Must be an array of [start, end] pairs.
Start time cannot be greater than end time.
